name: Power conversion cabinet
summary: A generic envelope for the selected power-conversion equipment and its interfaces.
description: A PCS cabinet represents physical power-conversion equipment, such as the AC/DC interface in a battery energy storage system. It should link to the exact selected product and documented AC, DC, controls and auxiliary interfaces.
readingNotes: Read the equipment boundary and interface labels from the system documentation.
Use manufacturer information for access, cooling and connection arrangements.
drawingChecklist: Identify AC and DC connection interfaces.
distinction: A converter symbol identifies an electrical function. A PCS cabinet is physical equipment with a model-specific footprint.
